items: You learned how to style tables using CSS by adding borders, padding, aligning text, and adding captions.
You explored different ways to customize lists by changing or removing bullet types.
You styled links to change colors based on user interaction.
You styled different form elements individually.

blocks.content: In the next chapter, you'll dive into advanced CSS techniques. You'll learn about flexbox, which will allow you to create complex and responsive designs.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
